opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motions of Breazeale, Sachse & Wilson, LLP, and DRI-The Voice of the Defense Bar for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari in No. 12-79 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Certiorari in No. 12-86 granted. Certiorari in No. 12-88 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Cases consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 675 F. 3d 503.
